agency#orgGrantPermits.reason: answers whether an organization's grant reaches a case: a yes or no about the organization, never a record; every caller checks the person first (mayReadOrgCase, loadMissionForOrgWrite, the access gate)

agency#listAssignedMissionIds.reason: the case ids one member is assigned to, used by access-ends.ts after its own membership check; taken off the package entry in this change (nothing outside used it)

agency#applicantsSharedWithOrganization.reason: the shared-client set behind listApplicantsForOrganization (admin checked) and the storage and plan counters (quotas, plans, entitlement-enforcement), which return numbers only

access/grant-scope#orgCaseRecordVisibleS.reason: a SQL condition (an organization's grant still reaches a case record), placed inside reads that have already checked the person

plans#countPendingInvitations.reason: a count for the plan limit checks, called inside writes that checked the actor

plans#countActiveSeats.reason: a count for the plan limit checks, called inside writes that checked the actor

plans#countCasesInPeriod.reason: a count for the plan limit checks, called inside writes that checked the actor

plans#countConcurrentOpenCases.reason: a count for the plan limit checks, called inside writes that checked the actor

entitlement-enforcement#checkSeatEntitle.reason: the seat limit, run as the first statement of a membership write whose caller already checked the admin

entitlement-enforcement#checkInvitationE.reason: the invitation limit, run inside an invitation write whose caller already checked the admin

entitlement-enforcement#checkCaseCreatio.reason: the case limit of the organization that owns a new case, run inside createMission's own checked transaction

quotas#getOrganizationEvidenceBytes.reason: a storage total in bytes (a number, never a record) for the plan and usage counters, whose own callers check the member

founding-access#assignFoundingAccess.reason: gives a newly created agency its starting plan, inside the creating transaction of createOrganization

billing-standing#lockBillingAccount.reason: locks the agency's billing account inside the billing run's or a staff action's transaction

billing-standing#overdueInvoices.reason: overdue invoices for the daily billing run and billing.ts reads, never shown directly

billing-standing#toBillingStanding.reason: shapes a standing from rows the caller already read

billing-standing#readBillingStanding.reason: the standing of a billing account the caller has already locked

billing-standing#billingContacts.reason: who billing notices go to (the agency's active owners and admins), for the billing run and staff billing actions

billing-standing#agencyCode.reason: the first 8 hex characters of an organization id, for invoice references

billing-standing#agencyName.reason: the agency's name for the opening line of a billing notice, written by the billing run

billing-standing#invoicesPath.reason: builds the address of the agency's Invoices page; reads nothing

billing-cycle#cycleInvoiceRef.reason: builds an invoice reference from an organization id and a date

billing-documents#buildInvoiceDocument.reason: builds an invoice document from facts the caller already read and checked

billing-documents#buildReceiptDocument.reason: builds a receipt document from facts the caller already read and checked

receipts#issueReceiptForPayment.reason: issues the receipt for one recorded payment, inside applyInvoiceCollection's locked transaction

payments#attemptView.reason: shapes one payment attempt row the caller already read for display

billing#isBillingSuspended.reason: whether the agency's billing reads Suspended: a yes or no about the agency, no record; no web caller

commercial-override#isCommercialOverride.reason: whether an override is live (a yes or no, no record), for the entitlement checks of writes that checked the actor

commercial-override#listCommercialOverri.reason: the owner's organization page only, after its isPlatformOwnerAccount check (apps/web admin/organizations/[orgId])

plans#getCurrentPlanForOrganization.reason: the owner's organization page only, after its isPlatformOwnerAccount check (apps/web admin/organizations/[orgId])

plans#getPendingDowngradeForOrganization.reason: the owner's organization page (after its platform owner check) and the agency Plan page (after getUsageForOrganization has refused anyone who is not an active member)

organizations#reviewOrganization.reason: approve or reject an agency application; the admin action checks ORGANIZATION_REVIEW and step-up first, and the service refuses a member of that agency

organizations#suspendOrganization.reason: suspend an agency; the admin action checks ORGANIZATION_SUSPEND and step-up first

organizations#terminateOrganization.reason: end an agency; the admin action checks its staff permission and step-up first

organizations#getOrganization.reason: one organization row (name, status), read by the agency console after its membership read and by staff pages after their staff check

branding#getOrganizationBrandingForDispl.reason: the agency's name, colour and logo address, shown on its pages and on invitations it sends; no client or case data

branding#readOrganizationLogo.reason: the agency's logo image for the signed-in logo route and invitation pages; no client or case data

branding#organizationLogoPath.reason: builds the logo's address from an organization id and a version

notifications#enqueueNotification.reason: queues one notice inside the transaction of the business write it reports on, which checked its own actor; recipients are re-checked when it is sent

notifications#enqueueNotificationBothCha.reason: the same as enqueueNotification, for the in-app and email copies together

notifications#billingNoticeStillAllowedS.reason: a SQL condition that hides a billing notice from someone no longer an active owner or admin; it is itself that membership rule, used inside notice reads

product-events#recordProductEvent.reason: appends one product event inside the transaction of the checked business write it describes; reads nothing back

invitation-email#queueInvitationEmail.reason: queues the email of an invitation its caller just created after checking its own actor

access/guest-submission-access#guestSubm.reason: the notification worker's send-time check that a guest submission is still live for its agency; a yes or no, no record

access/guest-correction-notice#guestCorr.reason: the notification worker's send-time check of a guest correction email

access/collection-response-access#agency.reason: whether the agency is reviewed (ACTIVE): a yes or no about the agency itself

access/collection-response-access#collec.reason: the notification worker's send-time check that a response is still live
whether the signed-in account is the person an agency link was sent to (its email), checked against the link, not a membership

documents#issueEvidenceSubmissionReadRef.reason: mints the link to a sent evidence copy for a caller that already checked the agency proof and the identity confirmation

document-access-token#signDocumentAccess.reason: signs a document access token from fields the caller already authorized

document-access-token#verifyDocumentAcce.reason: checks a token's signature and expiry; the file route then checks the person

document-access-token#appendDocumentAcce.reason: adds a token's fields to an address

ai-feature-settings#aiOrganizationContex.reason: builds the context of an agency a service has already shown the caller acts for (a live owner or admin membership)

ai-feature-settings#aiEntitlementFor.reason: what a plan allows for an AI feature, for a subject the caller already resolved; returns limits, never anyone's record

ai-feature-settings#getAiUsageToday.reason: today's AI use counts for the signed-in account itself (lib/ai-usage.ts passes only that account); counts only

access/agency-ai-scope#agencyAiSettingOn.reason: whether an agency's own AI setting is on, read inside openAgencyAiScope after its membership check

access/agency-ai-connections#endAgencyAi.reason: ends a member's AI connections when an admin turns that member off, inside setMembershipActive's checked transaction

entitlements#resolveEntitlements.reason: what a subject's plan allows now, for callers that checked who the subject is; returns limits and switches, never a record

pack-matching#listFittingAgencyPacks.reason: the agency's published lists that fit a case's country and purpose; its caller (umpe-pack-selection) passes the case's own agency after the access gate on that case; list names, no client data
